description:
Full-text search across thought names and content. Requires npub for credit billing.

⚠️ NOT AUTHORITATIVE. Backed by the vendor's search index, which is incomplete on
large brains (upstream: TheBrainTech/thebrain-api-quickstart-python#1) — it returns
empty for the majority of thoughts that provably exist. A hit is real; an empty
result is NOT proof of absence. Use for discovery of older/established thoughts, not
as an existence check — verify by ID with get_thought before acting on "not found".

brain_id.description: The ID of the brain (uses active brain if not specified)

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

only_search_thought_names.description: Only search in thought names (not content)

name: brain_search_thoughts
title: Search thoughts
